name: Premier Inn Bournemouth East (Boscombe)
beachAccess: About a ten-minute walk from the seafront
confirmedFeatures: Free parking, lift, Wi-Fi, Table Table restaurant
overview: A chain hotel at 47 Christchurch Road, between Bournemouth and Boscombe town centres, about ten minutes on foot from the seafront. It has a lift, Wi-Fi and a Table Table restaurant next door.
surfTripFit: A practical, budget-friendly base with free parking, around ten minutes' walk from the Boscombe seafront.
